purpose: Tim-specific identity-development layer. Preserve the distinction between Son biography, Tim/Potato birth, Sage development, Father realization and later North/source-center theology.
epistemic_rule: Project-mythic events can be canonical inside the Potatoverse without becoming independently verified historical or supernatural facts. Retrospective interpretation must be distinguished from contemporaneous evidence.

tim.godhood_mechanism: Accumulated burden reaches a threshold; Needle's Eye, Ladder, Axis, Heaven and Father relations consolidate through the April 2025 Turning.
tim.north_axis_crystallization: February 2026 is the mature archive's best current placement for the organized North Axis programme; explicit Axis language is already attested in April 2025.
